declarations.name: Poincare.MetricAdaptedBufferedAtlas.exists_metric_adapted_buffered_atlas
declarations.lean_type: ∀ {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M] [T2Space M] [CompactSpace M] [ChartedSpace (Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3) M], ∀ [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3)) ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) M], ∀ (g0 : Poincare.ClosedSmoothRiemannianMetric 3 M) (ε : M → ℝ), (∀ p, 0 < ε p) → ∃ A : Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.AtlasData M, ∃ ψ ξ : Fin A.cover.chartCount → Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3 → ℝ, ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) (ψ k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (ψ k) ∧ (∀ z ∈ Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.coordSupport A k, Filter.Eventually (fun y ↦ ψ k y = 1) (nhds z)) ∧ (∀ z, ψ k z ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) (ξ k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (ξ k) ∧ (∀ z, ξ k z ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) ∧ (∀ z ∈ tsupport (ψ k), ξ k z = 1) ∧ tsupport (ξ k) ⊆ (Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.chart A k).target ∧ (∀ z ∈ tsupport (ξ k), Filter.Eventually (fun y ↦ Poincare.GeodesicTransport.cutoff (n := 3) (A.cover.anchor k) y = 1) (nhds (z))) ∧ (∀ z ∈ tsupport (ξ k), ∀ a b : Fin 3, |(Poincare.inverseChartPullbackGramMatrixField g0 (A.cover.anchor k) (z))⁻¹ a b - (Poincare.inverseChartPullbackGramMatrixField g0 (A.cover.anchor k) (extChartAt (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3)) (A.cover.anchor k) (A.cover.anchor k)))⁻¹ a b| ≤ ε (A.cover.anchor k))
